title: Ingenuity
tagline: The first aircraft to fly on another planet.
kicker: A true story from Mars · 2021 to 2024
mystery: Can anything fly in air that thin?
p1.where: Jezero Crater, Mars. The Perseverance rover landed here on 18 February 2021.
p1.hello: Shh! I'm Ingenuity. I rode all the way to Mars under the rover's belly.
p1.small: I'm tiny: just 1.8 kg, with rotors 1.2 m from tip to tip.
p1.feet: 3 April 2021. Four feet on Mars. Now I'm on my own!
p2.night: My first night alone on Mars. It gets very, very cold.
p2.panel: My solar panel charged my batteries in the day. Can they last the night?
p2.hint: Keep the battery above zero. Heat when it drops, sleep to save power.
p2.win: 4 April 2021: I survived my first night on Mars!
p3.date: 19 April 2021. Time to try something nobody has ever done.
p3.thin: The air on Mars is extremely thin. My blades must spin very fast.
p3.hint: Hold to spin up and climb. Keep the gauge in the green to hover.
p3.win: I'm flying! The first powered, controlled flight on another planet!
p3.wright: People called it a Wright Brothers moment.
p4.date: 25 April 2021. From up here I can see my friend.
p4.hint: Look down from the helicopter. Tap the rover, not the rocks.
p4.miss: That's a rock! Look for wheels.
p4.win: There it is! My first photo of the rover from the air.
p5.plan: I was built to test flying: no more than five flights in 30 days.
p5.scout: But I kept going, as a scout for the rover and its team.
p5.goal: How many flights did I make?
p5.hint: Tap to fly again and again!
p5.totals: 128.8 minutes in the air, 17.0 km flown, up to 24.0 m high.
p6.proud: I was planned for five flights. I flew 72.
p6.bye: Next time you see a bird, remember me, flying on Mars.
